comment: The trajectory build, against tool_ops.json on tool_scene.xyz with tool_dump.xyz on feedstocks and tool_tip.xyz / tool_probe.xyz on tools. One run of habst_tool spanning three visits - abstract, recharge on the reservoir, abstract again - with a settle *inside* it, so a tool hovers over its next site while the crystal rearranges; then the bare probe's single visit, which ends that run; then a bulk step, which nothing visits. Every run shape this design distinguishes appears exactly once.

steps.note: the charged tip leaves park, takes methane A's +z hydrogen and goes spent
methane A relaxes into the vacancy while the tip hovers over the reservoir
the recharge, reached without going home: the same run's second visit
the run's last visit, after which the tip flies home
the bare probe's own run of one visit - a second tool's tip step, which is what ended the first run
one site's share of the X2 dose; a bulk step has no visit and every tool is at park
